question: Where was the first underground railway started in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** first underground railway **in India was started in **Kolkata,** also known as the **Kolkata Metro.**
 
• The **construction of the Kolkata Metro **started in **1972 **and the first line was opened for **commercial services in 1984.**
 
• The Kolkata Metro is currently the** oldest underground railway** in India and operates over **27 kilometers, covering 24 stations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Mumbai Metro started its **first line in 2014** and currently operates over **11 kilometers,** covering **12 stations.**
 
• **Chennai and Pune** do not have operational underground railways, although Chennai has an** elevated railway system** known as the **Chennai Metro Rail.**
